entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Diana at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm just so sad. I bought a VeloBand Cadence Sensor a little while ago, and it's just not working. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and I'm just really disappointed.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that you're having trouble. I definitely want to help figure this out for you. To start, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a technical fault, for sure. It feels like the device is broken. It worked for a couple of weeks, but now it won't sync with the app at all. I've tried everything. I think the sensor must be defective.
I understand, that sounds incredibly frustrating when a new device stops working as it should. Let me pull up your account to see what we can do. Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF886-34901. I just... I really needed this money, you know? I saved up for it, so to have it break so soon is just... heartbreaking.

I completely understand your position. Thank you for that order number. One moment... Okay, I see your VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, so that's 41 days ago. Let me just check our return eligibility for you.
Alright, I've checked the policy. It looks like you are well within our 90-day return window for a full refund.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was going to be stuck with a broken gadget.

Yes, absolutely. Since you're reporting it as defective, I've gone ahead and processed a return authorization for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just place the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Wow. Thank you so much, Diana. You've been so helpful. This really turns my day around.
It's my pleasure to help. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
